issues_detected.description: hba1c minimum_value/maximum_value hold the laboratory reference range (4.0-6.0%), not the observed range; in a T2DM cohort observed values will exceed 6.0. The record's notes flag this.

strengths: Collection protocol documented instrument by instrument with parameters, operators, training and timeframes
Complete ethics coverage: IRB protocol number and date, consent route and withdrawal terms, compensation amount, CAB and named ethics reviewers, honest statement that no DPIA was conducted
Strong interoperability: per-collection standards (CDS, WFDB, OMOP, DICOM, Open mHealth, ESDS, RO-Crate), Bridge2AI topic/substrate terms, ARK-identified subcrates
Use guidance tied to specific licence clauses, with prohibited, discouraged and intended uses and mitigation-backed impact statements
Demographic subgroup counts published per split and overall, arithmetically consistent, with explicit inclusion/exclusion criteria
Source conflicts are surfaced in source_caveats rather than silently resolved
weaknesses: Keyword list (7) under-represents the documented modalities and themes
No individual creator list; the single recorded affiliation conflicts with three other signals pointing to the University of Washington
Sustainability beyond the project is undocumented and prior versions are reported inaccessible
Software tools named without versions or per-tool repository URLs
Provenance is rich prose but not an explicit graph (no was_derived_from / parent_datasets links)
Bias taxonomy uses BiasTypeEnum but no AIO mappings or quantitative fairness metrics
recommendations: Add keywords for OCT/OCTA, wearable activity, environmental sensing, OMOP CDM and salutogenesis to reach ≥8
Resolve or dual-record the PI affiliation (UW vs WashU St. Louis) and verify the licensor ROR against the licence text
Populate parent_datasets / was_derived_from for versions 1.0.0 and 2.0.0 to make the lineage machine-readable
Record versions and repository URLs for REDCap, OMOP Data Quality Dashboard, MoCA Duo and conversion pipelines from the AI-READI GitHub organisation
Document any preservation commitment for the FAIRhub/Azure hosting and the fate of prior versions
Leave hba1c minimum/maximum empty or replace with observed bounds; reference ranges belong in notes
